title: Route production clones through the Cluster Router
description:
A candidate clone placed in an active Cluster receives its private preview Route through the Cluster Router and the target workload’s exact private serving projection.

## Scope

* In: Cluster-scoped clone placement, preview routing, private certificates, firewall, Caddy, and recoverable publication.
* Out: public Ingress, multi-target routing, deployment commands, Node-TLD generation rules for other Routes, and application health gates.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The clone request works for a candidate on another authorized Node and a destination in an active Cluster, preserving the same target configuration and optional SQLite behavior as standalone cloning; the preview always uses the production Node TLD even when the Cluster has another TLD. Proof: Incus action `cluster-clone-preview`.
- [ ] The sole Route is Cluster-scoped and private, with separate Orbit-CA identities for Router and workload, private firewall policy, and the owning dedicated PHP socket where required; preparation completes before first deployment without requiring HTTP success. Proof: Incus action `cluster-clone-infrastructure`.
- [ ] After an explicit deployment of a minimal fixture, a trusted request through the Router and an exact workload override preserve Host and TLS server name and reach the selected release; no public listener or Ingress certificate is created by cloning. Proof: Incus action `cluster-clone-request-path`.
- [ ] Missing Router, incompatible placement, certificate failure, or an occupied hostname reports a bounded failed boundary; interruption and retry preserve completed clone configuration and data and create no duplicate AppInstance, Route, target, or certificate state. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Domain/CloneAppInstanceTest.php` and Incus action `cluster-clone-retry`.
- [ ] Maintained documentation describes Cluster clone placement, preview paths, private TLS, and recovery, and generated context is current. Proof: `composer docs-lint`.
- [ ] Changed project checks and repository suites pass. Proof: `cd apps/gateway && composer check`, and all five full no-TIA CI suites on the submitted candidate, plus focused affected Pest tests locally.
